patterns: APPSC asks appointing-authority pairs: CIC by President, SIC by Governor, PIO designated by public authority (not SC/Parliament).
Other PSCs repeatedly ask CVC = Santhanam Committee recommendation; CBI 1963 and founder Director D.P. Kohli; BHARATPOL developed by CBI.
UPSC uses 'how many rows correctly matched' on agency-function-ministry (CBI = DoPT, ED/DRI = Finance, SFIO = Corporate Affairs).
Traps: CBI non-statutory vs CVC statutory (2003); CIC panel has a PM-nominated minister, CVC panel the Home Minister, CBI panel the CJI.
App goes deeper (Directorate of Prosecution, Vineet Narain citation, 2026 current affairs) than the direct one-liners APPSC uses.
